title: Make guidance resume idempotent and reject stale sequences
narrative: Duplicate resume with the same idempotency key returns the committed result; a conflicting or stale sequence fails safely so drivers can retry without double-applying advice. Tracks R-IOC-IDEMPOTENT[^insp-ioc-06].
implementation: `DurableGraphGenerator.resume` stores results under `idempotency_key` and compares `expected_sequence` to the run record.
validation: Harness `cli` via `scenario.yaml`. Hard expects duplicate key same sequence and stale rejection.
